clues.text: Its queen heard of King Solomon's fame and came to test him with difficult questions.
Its queen told Solomon that not even half of his wisdom and prosperity had been reported to her.
Never again were spices in such abundance brought in as those its queen gave King Solomon.
A royal psalm prays that gold from this land would be given to the king.
Isaiah foresaw people from this land coming with camels, bearing gold and frankincense and praising the LORD.
Through Jeremiah, God asked what use frankincense from this land was when Judah's sacrifices did not please Him.
In Ezekiel's lament over Tyre, merchants from this land traded gold, the finest spices, and precious stones there.
